title: Why A Big Mac Costs So Much More In Switzerland
hook: Same burger costs four times more in Switzerland than in Taiwan.
closing: A burger can show whose money goes furthest. Check the price tag before you travel.
question: What's a Big Mac cost near you?

segments.say: A Big Mac in Switzerland costs $9.08. In Taiwan, it's about a quarter of that.
Switzerland's Big Mac costs 48% more than the US one. Same burger, so a dollar there buys much less.
In Taiwan, the Big Mac costs less than half the US price. So Taiwan's money looks cheap against the dollar.
